summary: Section 138 NI Act cases dismissed for non-appearance; recorded evidence and completed cross-examination existed; proviso to s.256 CrPC permits proceeding without complainant; failure to consider admissible evidence; reliance on S. Anand and Associated Cement Co; mere non-appearance insufficient after evidence closure; dismissal overturned; case restored to pre-dismissal stage
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.256(1), proviso
final_judgment: Impugned orders set aside; proceedings restored to stage before dismissal; complainant's absence insufficient for acquittal after evidence recorded.
